title: Modular Dashboard for Smart Contracts
tagline: We have demonstrates a modular design for smart contracts to interact with each other through a visual dashboard.
description: We have demonstrates a modular design for smart contracts to interact with each other through a visual dashboard. This involves running web3.py with custom abstractions that bind input output interactions with smart contracts. Developers are allowed to collaberate and test between multiple wallets.
